newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan will firmly support banks on bad loans - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan will firmly support banks on bad loans - MOF.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry will firmly support Japan's major 20 banks in their effort to resolve their bad loan problems, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Monday.
Asked whether Japanese authorities have a policy of not letting the major banks fail, Mitsuzuka said the ministry would support the banks' efforts to improve their financial health.
"The banks are doing their best to tackle the bad loan issue. As the Finance Minister, it is my duty to firmly support the 20 major banks," Mitsuzuka said.

Kimio Yamaguchi, director-general of the ministry's Banking Bureau, told the same parliamentary committee that the ministry's policy was to deal with any difficulties at the 20 banks in such a way as to avoid causing confusion in both domestic and overseas financial markets.
